a.lede: OpenAI has launched GPT-6.1 Terra, a new model focused on computer use, visual reasoning, coding, and everyday work, while costing significantly less than its larger models. [...]
a.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Terra with 3x faster AI agents, 50% lower pricing

b.lede: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is reportedly weighing annual software fees of around $2,000 per GPU for enterprise AI, a model that could generate $10 billion a year if five million licenses were sold. The pricing and launch timeline remain unconfirmed, while Nvidia continues to expand its AI software and security tools for enterprise customers.
b.title: Nvidia discusses $2,000-per-GPU annual fee for software that 'runs agents on AI factories'
